# MatOps

> MatOps is admin software for Brazilian jiu-jitsu (BJJ) academies. Owners and coaches run the class schedule, students and attendance on the web. Students book classes from the MatOps app or the web.

MatOps is in an early pilot with a small number of academies. There is no public pricing yet.

## What it does

- Weekly class schedule built from templates, with classes colored by discipline (for example Gi, No-Gi, Kids). The schedule can be printed as a poster.
- Students join an academy with an invite link or a 6-digit join code. The owner approves each student before they can book.
- Approved students book and cancel classes from their phone. Class size is a soft limit: staff see when a class is over, and nobody is refused.
- When staff cancel or change a booked class, every booked student gets an email and a push notification.
- Coaches take attendance, and staff record belts and stripes.
- A drop-in link lets visitors fill in a short form and book or mark themselves present at a class.

## Who it is for

- Owners and managers of a single BJJ or grappling academy.
- Coaches who teach and take attendance there.
- Students who train there.

## Links

- [Home](https://matops.app/): what MatOps does, with screenshots of the schedule
- [Start a gym](https://matops.app/start): create an academy (name and time zone)
- [Sign in](https://matops.app/sign-in): email sign-in link, no password
- [Privacy notice](https://matops.app/privacy): what MatOps stores and how to have it removed
